author: Ethan Mollick
basis: Organizational synthesis with named author demonstration
reported_outcomes: Reports testing an agent against a business simulation and finding both strengths and errors; organization-wide effects of the full framework are not evaluated here.
proposed_outcomes: Share discoveries, test actual work and adapt workflows with accountable domain expertise.
limits: Adoption and time saved do not establish improved human capability.
Vibe benchmarks can be biased and should not settle consequential reliability.
Broad privacy/compliance assertions and urgency framing are excluded.
review_note: Retain the employee-discovery, expert-test, feedback sequence; separate the source’s growth aims from this KB’s capability questions.
coverage: Close-read all 87 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
